title: Dimension-free log-concave Poincare or Cheeger constant
current_openness: UNKNOWN; recent primary preprints claim a complete solution

exact_statement.quantifiers: There is a universal C>0 such that for every n>=1 and every full-dimensional isotropic log-concave probability measure mu on R^n, CP(mu)<=C.
exact_statement.normalization: E_mu X=0 and Cov_mu(X)=I_n. CP is the smallest c for Var_mu(f)<=c integral |grad f|^2 dmu for locally Lipschitz f in L2(mu) of finite Dirichlet energy.
exact_statement.equivalent_covariance_form: For a full-dimensional log-concave mu with covariance Sigma, ||Sigma||op<=CP(mu)<=C||Sigma||op.
exact_statement.cheeger_form: A universal positive lower bound for the Euclidean Cheeger constant in isotropic position; equivalence uses log-concavity and the appropriate reverse Cheeger/Buser theorem, not Cheeger alone.
